Sam Tran: Quick q — I bumped my HSA deferral to 6% after last month's raise and HR adds the employer top-up. Payroll vendor cutover next Fri — will that split the top-up between vendors or could it create a duplicate? 🤔
Riley Chen: tagging @Olivia Park cause cutover checklist lives with you. we didn't document HSA top-up mapping in the last runbook.
Olivia Park: Short: payroll computes employer top-up in our payroll system, not the vendor. We send contribution records to whichever vendor is active for that pay period, so normally no duplicate.
Olivia Park: Longer: for a pay period that spans cutover we generate a final file for the old vendor and an initial file for the new vendor based on the mapping key. If the deduction/contribution code isn't mapped consistently the new vendor might treat it as a separate line item.
Ben Alvarez: Finance ask — confirm the deduction code name with the incoming vendor. If they parse it differently it might show up as an extra employer contribution on stubs.
Olivia Park: Runbook snippet to include in vendor onboarding: 
```
employee_id,deduction_code,amount
12345,HSA_EMP_TOPUP,75.00
```
Tell new vendor to map `HSA_EMP_TOPUP` -> employer_topup (not generic employer_contribution).
Sam Tran: I already changed my employee % in the payroll portal. Anything else I should watch for?
Riley Chen: No action from you @Sam. People-ops will validate the post-cutover payroll reconciliations and ping if YTD employer top-ups don't reconcile.
payroll-bot: Payroll vendor migration scheduled: 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC. Affected modules: HSA, FSA, Garnishments. See #payroll-alerts for live updates. :construction:
Olivia Park: If you spot a duplicate employer top-up on your pay stub after the migration, please open a ticket to payroll@redwood.com with a screenshot and pay period date. We'll reverse/correct on the next run if needed. Note: employer top-ups are prorated by pay cycle, so mid-cycle changes may appear partial.
Ben Alvarez: FYI, retro corrections are typically processed as an off-cycle adjustment which may affect tax withholdings; payroll will flag for tax team.
Sam Tran: Thanks everyone, appreciate the clarity :thumbsup:
